tagline: Foam right to every edge, so they can lie anywhere without sinking to the floor.
lead: Wherever your dog lies down, even right at the edge, there's foam under them and no sinking through to the floor.
value: Two layers doing two jobs: memory foam on top contours to them, and a firmer base stops them bottoming out.
intro: Cypress is an edge-to-edge dog mattress: a contouring memory foam top layer over a firmer foam base, with no walls, in Medium, Large and XL up to 140 × 100cm. The cover comes off to wash.
points: Contouring memory foam over a firmer supporting base.
No soft rim to roll off and no dead space around the outside.
A level mattress they can step onto from any side, at any age.
Three sizes, up to 140 × 100cm, for dogs who never fit a standard mattress.
best_for: Side sleepers, sprawlers, and big dogs who never fit on a standard mattress.
fit_note: Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. Every centimetre is usable sleeping area, so there's no need to allow for bolsters. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Two-Layer Edge-to-Edge Memory Foam Dog Mattress | Snoozly
seo_description: Memory foam right to every edge, so the whole surface is usable. A two-layer dog mattress with no walls, for sprawlers and big dogs. Medium to XL.
